rend: My edge was still in him when I fell.
I would not drop it. They took the fingers.
I wanted the one who laughed. Only him.
My brother lay behind me. I kept cutting.
I smelled his blood before my own.
The low field was red. Not all mine.
I cut at the dark until it closed.
The miller's boy ran past. I wouldn't.
break: I put my shoulder to the gate. Again.
The shield split. My arm went with it.
The bridge still stood when I went down.
I broke his jaw. He kept smiling.
The smith's hammer. I swung it until dark.
Kicked at the door until the door won.
Bone on bone. I heard both go.
I wanted their wall down. Only the wall.
sting: Whoever takes me takes the knife too.
I bit his hand. He let go first.
I kept a blade in my boot. For him.
Let him carry the splinter. Let it fester.
My girl spat at them. I taught her.
I pulled the arrow out and threw it back.
Salt in his eyes. Salt in mine.
Every hand that held me came away bleeding.
ward: I held the door. They were still inside.
My back to the cart. The little ones underneath.
Let them hit. The house is behind me.
The shield arm went numb. I kept it up.
Somebody tell me when I can stop.
Mother's roof leaked. I meant to mend it.
I wore my father's mail. It was too big.
Hold the gap. Someone said hold the gap.
still: Don't move. If I don't move, it passes.
I held my breath and waited for morning.
The pond froze that night. So did I.
My hand on her hair. Keep it there.
The candle didn't flicker. I watched it all night.
Wait. Let me finish the furrow first.
I lay so still the crows came close.
sink: I kept my boots. The mud kept me.
Down the well. Cool. Quiet. Mine.
I buried the silver under the hearthstone.
Heavy. Everything heavy. Don't take the pack.
The peat cutting. I sleep there now.
Hold my feet down. I'm not leaving the farm.
Water over my ears. Her voice, through it.
My roots are here. Dig them out yourself.
hunger: The bread was for my sister. I ate it.
Warm. He was still warm. I drank.
The sacks were empty. We ate the seed.
I forget her face. I remember the soup.
Just a mouthful more, then I'll go.
Gnawed the harness leather. Tasted like the horse.
I sucked the wound. It wasn't mine.
flee: The road was open. I didn't look back.
Left the old man at the gate. Ran.
Faster. If I'm quick, it can't follow.
I hid in the barley till they passed.
Someone was calling. I pretended not to hear.
Over the hill, and I'd be no one.
The bell rang behind me. I kept going.
Down the far bank. The water took my tracks.
